LESSON: BELIEF IN ANGELS 3.2.1 CHARACTERISTICS OF ANGELS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the significance of believing in angels?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman
2. appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BELIEF IN ANGELS 3.2.1 CHARACTERISTICS OF ANGELS
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BELIEF IN ANGELS 3.2.1 CHARACTERISTICS OF ANGELS
Study Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: State the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman

What this means
In this part you learn to state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels in your own words. (skill: appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the significance of believing in angels?
2. How can Muslims show obedience to Allah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: state the characteristics of angels to strengthen their iman.
5. Be able to: appreciate the belief in angels as a pillar of iman.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
